reader_facing.feature_kicker: COMPANY BENEFITS / THE SPARE EMPLOYEE DISPENSER

feature_columns.heading: A generous provision
feature_columns.text: Mainframe Plumbing & Supply would like you to know that arrangements have been made. The Spare Employee Dispenser stands ready between service calls, its glass front offering a reassuring view of the company’s preparations. There is rust around the hinges and something familiar about the occupants. The accompanying leaflet describes them as reserve personnel. It asks employees to respect their rest and directs all further questions to the same leaflet.

feature_columns.heading: Your position is secure
feature_columns.text: The leaflet is particularly clear on continuity of service. Your assignments will remain on the schedule, your tools will still be required, and your name will stay on the rota. Several paragraphs explain how much the company values an experienced employee. The section headed “What this means for you” refers back to those paragraphs. We would have preferred a little more detail, but the cabinet does appear to be well stocked.

reader_facing.feature_caption: The company asks that reserve personnel not be disturbed.

back_cover.headline: We have your next shift covered.
back_cover.left_text: Mainframe has made provisions for uninterrupted service. Please familiarize yourself with the cabinet nearest your assignment.
back_cover.right_text: Please leave the glass undisturbed. The personnel inside are not available to answer questions.
back_cover.closing: Your name is already on the schedule.
